description: This file implements the ServiceAdministrator class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, managing service registration, instantiation, and library reference handling.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Manages registration, instantiation, and lifecycle of services and libraries within the framework.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a service with given metadata and factory.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a service with given metadata and factory.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ServiceAdministrator.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of a service based on name, version, and interface number.

methods.name: ReleaseLibrary
methods.description: Releases a library reference and adds it to unreferenced list.
